body:
This separate successor to PR13 repairs nine existing findings across eleven bounded row facets: Modules Calendar scope/date/view, task occurrences and exact Planner links; current saved-signature preview and local rewrite Undo; supplied Work owner/status presentation; Prospect Files search; and uncertain file-deletion recovery. Peer review corrected stale signature display, Calendar scope navigation, failed recovery reads and superseded deletion-read handling before qualification. The frozen `d5dd0be` shipping checkpoint remains unchanged.

Qualified source: **`ee01be3b2c5c64a53744994ae4ad0d992a111054`**; root tree `bce79ae8c0f526e113468b885fc2c7a5515ac7b9`, `apps/web` tree `17385e9404d12baa01e695c72584a375f4842813`, application-source tree `7b269ad4ecdd3071acb0a0fec9775a2190458388`. Publication commit **`7aca86e7d64cfdb85d09d424a07e6186339fc24c`** adds evidence and documentation only. The canonical shared boundaries remain intact; root adapted the existing test transports/session mock and exact structure-review registrations without weakening guard rules or meaningful assertions.

Validation on that one source passed:

- Clean install; public-package, type, lint, format, architecture, transport and unit checks: **1,432 tests**. Zero lint errors, 76 inherited warnings; zero architecture blockers, 24 inherited unreviewed signals retained.
- **182 Modules +1,051 Portfolio/Meri browser tests**, zero failures/skips/flakes/retries. Modules uses one worker and 60 seconds; Portfolio uses three workers, a 60-second default and four existing 180-second slow cases. Original assertions and slow declarations remain unchanged.
- **15 Elements checks**, one production build (`YeRpCYwLZ8c5jqEhEYTc5`), and actual standalone-server smoke: 11 HTTP checks, four desktop/mobile light/dark states, two cross-mode/history records, zero page errors. Synthetic browser checks cover session expiry/sign-out, actor/org/tenant/client replacement and interrupted writes. Live sign-in is unrun.

The initial Elements invocation lacked its required SSR receipt (12 passed/3 failed). Its raw failure remains preserved; the properly prepared exact-source artifact passed all 15 without source changes. Source regressions and corrected interim review failures are also retained. Independent audits verify exact lane bindings, original tests/ledger preservation, evidence integrity and source archive identity. The archive has **8,211 tracked blobs**, **770,461,228 bytes**, SHA-256 **`6d9297afed3c0447783472c4d3e19a9b20ee50b8c8729321d27b369eeac5b61e`**; no cloud upload occurred.

**Eighteen original source/design findings remain open. All 337 native Portfolio rows remain unaccepted.** Native persistence/authorization/provider effects, full visual/accessibility breadth, image/deployed-runtime qualification and shipping remain separate. Figma clipping and missing target-state limits are explicit. No merge, deployment, AWS/resource/credential action, security/database change, provider message, billing or paid-model workload occurred. Keep this PR draft; the designated shipping session owns any reviewed image or later shipping.
